title: Manuel Perez at the Roof Garden and Sidney Desvigne's band
summary: He left Tuxedo for Manuel Perez at the Roof Garden, then spent seven or eight years with Sidney Desvigne's Syncopators on sax.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Alto sax, yeah. They bought my first sax. And after, and I left them, I left them, and I went playing with Man Perez. You heard of Man Perez? Yes, sir, yeah. Well, I played with Man Perez on the roof guard. Oh, yeah. I played in the roof guard. We played in the roof guard for a couple of years. Many years. Yeah. I played. I left the roof guard and joined Sidney. Sidney was playing on the hall. Sidney Desvene. Sidney was playing on the... On the... Capital? On the Capitol. That's right. Not the Capitol. Yeah. Capital. Sidney was playing on the Capitol. And he quit the Capitol. And he organized a band. He's owned. He's owned Ronnie. Well, I joined his band. He was getting work. And he had a good man. And I played with Sidney. I played with Sidney for a long time. Sidney's Sudden Syncopators. Sidney's Sudden Syncopators, that's right.
Was that mostly on saxophone or clarinet?

I played saxophone in Little Clarity II with Sidney. And I played with Sidney for about seven years, seven, eight years. After I left Sidney, after I left Sidney, I went to play with, how do they call it, that fella, that fella, you know, died. Celestan? No, not Celestan. It wasn't not Celestan. Not yet. That fella. He used to play violin. You talking about Pierron? No, not Pierron. I used to play, not that fella. Deathstone. No, that fella. That tall fella, you know.
